ui.settings.search.field.label.role: accessible name of the settings search field
ui.settings.search.field.label.tone: sentence case, plain, second person implied
ui.settings.search.field.label.note: The field is the page's own search. Do not name a database or a feature; it searches this page and the backend's setting registry.

ui.settings.search.field.placeholder.role: placeholder inside the empty settings search field
ui.settings.search.field.placeholder.note: Repeats the field's name; a placeholder is not a sentence, so no full stop and no ellipsis.

ui.settings.search.empty.summary.role: first line of the panel's empty state (no query typed)
ui.settings.search.empty.summary.note: States what the box searches: this page's rows plus the connected service's registry. Never promise sources it does not read.

ui.settings.search.empty.shortcut.role: second line of the empty state, naming the keyboard shortcut

placeholders.shortcut: a literal keyboard chord such as ⌘F or Ctrl+F; do not translate or reorder its characters

ui.settings.search.empty.shortcut.note: The chord opens this field from anywhere on the settings page. Keep {shortcut} verbatim.

ui.settings.search.no_results.title.role: no-results heading, quoting the reader's query

placeholders.query: the reader's own text, quoted verbatim; it may be long, so allow wrapping

ui.settings.search.no_results.title.note: Use the locale's own quotation marks around {query}. Never reword or trim the query.

ui.settings.search.no_results.hint.role: one line under the no-results heading, naming the way out
ui.settings.search.no_results.hint.note: The button beside it clears the field; the sentence must not describe a second action that does not exist.

ui.settings.search.no_results.clear.note: Clears the query and returns the panel to its empty state. The only action offered in this state.

ui.settings.search.results.count.role: polite live region announcing how many results the current query has
ui.settings.search.results.count.length: Two or three words plus the number.

placeholders.count: integer greater than zero; keep the plural arms

ui.settings.search.results.count.note: Screen-reader announcement only. Use the locale's plural rules for the arms.

ui.settings.search.results.more.role: the line under the capped result list

placeholders.count: integer greater than zero, the number of results not shown; keep the plural arms

ui.settings.search.results.more.note: Says the list is capped rather than incomplete. It is a statement, not a button.

ui.settings.search.panel.label.role: accessible name of the results listbox
ui.settings.search.panel.label.note: Names the popup list attached to the field.

ui.settings.search.reason.label.role: why a result is shown, when the setting's own name matched
ui.settings.search.reason.label.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.label.note: Appended after the section context on a result row. Only use the arm whose field actually matched; the UI chooses.

ui.settings.search.reason.synonym.role: why a result is shown, when a related term (a synonym) matched
ui.settings.search.reason.synonym.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.synonym.note: A synonym is another word for the same setting, supplied by the setting's own registry entry.

ui.settings.search.reason.key.role: why a result is shown, when the setting's machine key matched
ui.settings.search.reason.key.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.key.note: 'Setting key' means the registry identifier such as web_search.enabled, not a keyboard key.

ui.settings.search.reason.choice.role: why a result is shown, when one of the setting's option labels matched
ui.settings.search.reason.choice.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.choice.note: An option is one of the values the setting can take, e.g. a theme name.

ui.settings.search.reason.section.role: why a result is shown, when the section it belongs to matched
ui.settings.search.reason.section.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.section.note: Used when the query matched a group's title, so every row in that group is offered.

ui.settings.search.reason.description.role: why a result is shown, when the setting's help or description matched
ui.settings.search.reason.description.tone: lowercase fragment, no capital, no full stop
ui.settings.search.reason.description.note: Used when the query matched the explanatory sentence under the setting's name, not its name.

ui.settings.search.jump.missing.role: polite announcement when Enter could not land on the row
ui.settings.search.jump.missing.note: The row exists in the index but is not currently rendered (its section is closed, or the surface is still loading).

ui.settings.search.row.section_hint.role: section context printed on a result row

placeholders.section: the section's own translated name, e.g. Appearance

ui.settings.search.row.section_hint.note: Says where the row lives. Keep {section} verbatim; the preposition may move in other languages.
